SELECT json_object('properties', json_object('__drivine.lower.email', k.k0), 'count', MAX(k.total),
                   'nodes', json_group_array(json_object('elementId', k.nid) ORDER BY k.nid) FILTER (WHERE k.position <= 10))
FROM (
    SELECT n.nid, (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' END) AS k0,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' END) ORDER BY n.nid) AS position,
           COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' END)) AS total
    FROM contracts_node n
    WHERE instr(n.labels, '"CiReturning"') > 0 AND (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."__drivine.lower.email"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."__drivine.lower.email"' END) IS NOT NULL
) k
WHERE k.total > 1
GROUP BY k0
LIMIT 10

FROM contracts_schema c
WHERE kind IN ('FULLTEXT_INDEX')
  AND (object_name IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'index' AND name = c.object_name))
ORDER BY label, properties

SELECT (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."version"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."version"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."version"' END) FROM schema_node n WHERE instr(n.labels, '"_DrivineSchema"') > 0 AND (CASE json_type(n.props, '$."scope"') WHEN 'text' THEN n.props ->> '$."scope"' WHEN 'null' THEN NULL ELSE n.props -> '$."scope"' END) = CAST($scope AS TEXT) ORDER BY (CASE WHEN json_type(n.props, '$."appliedAt"') IN ('integer', 'real') THEN n.props ->> '$."appliedAt"' END) DESC NULLS LAST, n.nid DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND lower(name) IN ('contracts_node', 'contracts_edge') AND sql NOT LIKE '%KEY AUTOINCREMENT%') THEN -1 ELSE COUNT(*) END FROM sqlite_master WHERE lower(name) IN ('contracts_node', 'contracts_edge', 'contracts_schema', 'contracts_edge_src', 'contracts_edge_dst')
